purpose: Compress structural candidates into a bounded localized-semantic-audit queue without upgrading structure into semantic claims.

FORMATION_ANCHOR.rule: Earliest non-control structural repair-anchor candidate by source_event_index; fall back to any repair-anchor candidate only if no non-control candidate exists.

PROPAGATION_ANCHOR.rule: Non-control candidate maximizing distinct_visible_actor_count, then later_visibility_count, then activity_after_visibility_count; earliest source_event_index breaks ties.

AUTHORITY_REVIEW_ANCHOR.rule: Earliest non-control candidate requiring authority review under the frozen lexical/status rule. Priority: fact carrying an explicit uncertainty marker, then provisional/unconfirmed, then unspecified.

authority_review.note: Marker/status matching is triage only. It does not establish semantic uncertainty, authority error, adoption, inheritance, inertia, CPR, or R5 eligibility.

claim_boundary: Triage ranks where semantic audit should look. It does not decide what any candidate means.
